website_summary.name: CleanEase Order Portal
website_summary.description: CleanEase Order Portal is a sleek, user-friendly platform designed for clients to order professional cleaning services with a modern and responsive interface.
website_summary.appearance: The website features a clean and organized layout with a prominent header that includes the title "Professional Cleaning Services" and two action buttons: "Get a Quote" and "Contact Us." The main content area is divided into four sections: "Select Service," "Quantity," "Schedule Cleaning," and "Order Summary." Each section is styled with rounded edges, soft shadows, and a light gray background for a modern look. The "Select Service" section offers three options: Apartment, Office, and Commercial, each with an icon and label. The "Quantity" section includes an input field for specifying the area in square meters. The "Schedule Cleaning" section has fields for selecting a date and time. The "Order Summary" section displays the selected service, area, date and time, and total cost, with a disabled "Place Order" button until all necessary fields are filled.
website_summary.functionality: The website allows users to select a cleaning service type (Apartment, Office, Commercial), specify the area in square meters, schedule a cleaning date and time, and view an order summary with the total cost. Users can also get a quote or contact the service provider directly. The order summary updates dynamically based on the user's selections, and the "Place Order" button becomes active once all required fields are completed.

functionality_testing.name: Apartment Service Selection Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the Apartment button correctly selects the apartment cleaning service.
functionality_testing.preconditions: UI is in the default state with no service selected.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The apartment service should be selected and indicated properly in the order summary section.
procedure: Click on the Apartment Button.
Verify if the selection gets highlighted.
Confirm the Order Summary reflects the selected apartment service.

functionality_testing.name: Commercial Service Selection Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the Commercial button selects the commercial service.
functionality_testing.preconditions: Initial state with no service selected.
procedure: Click on the Commercial button.
Verify that the "Service : " field in the Order Summary Card updates to "Commercial".

functionality_testing.name: Date Input Test

functionality_testing.preconditions: The webpage is loaded and the date input field is visible.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The date input field should accept the entered date and display it correctly.
procedure: Click on the Date Input textbox.
Enter a valid future date.
Verify that the date is accepted and displayed correctly.

functionality_testing.name: Date and Time Selection Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that entering "02/02/2024" in the Date Input textbox and selecting "13 : 00" from the Time Dropdown updates the date and time in the order summary.
procedure: Type "02/02/2024" into the Date Input textbox.
Select "13 : 00" from the Time Dropdown.
Verify that the "Date & Time : " field in the Order Summary Card updates to "02/02/2024 13:00".

functionality_testing.name: Office Button Test

procedure: Click on the Office button.

data_display_testing.name: Test Order Summary Card Data Display
